reading_aid.method: pdftotext -layout; actual PDF-page rasterizations by pdftoppm -png
reading_aid.role: Reading aid only; underlining/strike interpretation verified from rendered pixels.

findings.observation: Underlined (7) replaces struck (6) in the section 77-27,144 disclosure cross-reference.

Annual business-disclosure requirement is carried forward; its June 30 deadline is moved from old (6)(c) into new (7)(a). New (7)(b) allows a municipality to request a list of qualifying incentive applicants annually by June 30.

Surrounding tier-2 large-data-center investment/employment, exemption/refund and property-tax provisions appear as unamended text; no added investment/hiring threshold identified in this marked section.

Marked changes restructure municipal requests for tax information and permit defined limited sharing; they are municipal information-access changes, not a newly stated data-center investment/hiring threshold.

scope: Visual marked-text assessment of the retained enacted slip; no provision-specific effective-date, implementation or later-force acceptance. Raw PDF and images remain private.
